title: Be Careful
body: This game has some of the most aggressive gambling-style mechanics I’ve seen in a mobile game. Upgrading guns and armor relies heavily on random chance, meaning you can spend large amounts of real money and make almost no meaningful progress. I spent around $100 trying to upgrade armor and barely got anything out of it. The progression system feels intentionally designed to push repeated spending through low odds and constant retry mechanics. Even basic gameplay elements like ammo and resources become difficult to maintain without gems, which are primarily obtained through real-money purchases. Technically you can “play for free,” but the game becomes extremely grindy and restrictive unless you spend money. The monetization feels less like supporting a game and more like a casino system built around frustration and chasing upgrades. I would strongly caution anyone - especially younger players or people prone to impulsive spending - before getting invested in this game.

title: MadOut2 is amazing, but we need these changes !
body: Hello, MadOut2 developer(s)! I would like to share my opinion about this amazing game. Honestly, it is awesome! The cars, the skins, and everything the game has to offer are great. I have been playing for about two years now, and I have also spent money on the game because I genuinely enjoy it. However, there are a few things I would love to see improved. 1. The police in single-player mode (AI) One thing I don’t like is that when I’m driving peacefully and an NPC car crashes into me, the police come after me even though I didn’t do anything wrong. It would be great if you could fix this system and bring it back to how it used to be, when you could drive normally without the police chasing you because of accidents involving other vehicles. 2. Ambulances and NPCs I would also love to see the old feature return where, if you knocked an NPC unconscious, an ambulance would arrive and revive them. It was a great detail that made the game feel more realistic. 3. More weapons, vehicles, and locations It would be amazing if you added more weapons and vehicles, such as buses and small aircraft. It would also be great to expand the map or add new places to explore, because that would make the game even more fun. 4. More realistic traffic Lastly, I would like NPC vehicles to keep a more appropriate distance from each other and from the player, just like in real life. This would help prevent unnecessary crashes while driving peacefully around the city. Honestly, I really love this game, and I would love to see it continue to grow and improve.
